title: My dreams
content: Just wanted to share the reoccurring dreams I've been having for the last 5 or 6 years They started, I think, as a school type building, old, lots of stairs and I always would end up in the basements trying to find my way out, while VERY aware I am being kept there against my will for unknown reasons The school evolved many times, I would end up in places that seemed more like malls, big food courts and open areas with other people like me who were like "friends" but blissfully unaware that we are not allowed to leave this place. A lot of the time I end up trapped in the basement areas or bathrooms There's times I ended up in a part of it where it turns into an old victorian house, and there's people up in the attic who like me ARE aware of what's going on but it's hard to get to them and when I've reached them it's not made much sense/I've been sent back pretty immediately There's times im in an old brick building with a lot of separate segments that lead to different bars Times I'm in sometype of mountain town with big shopping center like buildings with lots of glass to look out of at the pretty mountain houses There's times I've made it outside, but its always the same few blocks outside of my actual house for some reason, and I can't go any further than that. Its always stormy. One of the times I got more than 3-4 streets away, I was even greeted with a massive wave of water, like a world ending amount of water. There's been times I've been picked up from the childhood house I grew up in, by what looks like a spaceship from the ground, but it's huge. I think once im inside there, I am in the sky city that contains all these different places. The funny thing is they almost always "start" as something entertaining, and then turn to an escape vibe, but while trying to leave, it's like the simulation itself will throw new entertaining scenes at me to crawl through to try to keep me there. Once ended up at the bottom of a huge tubed structure almost like what's built for hamsters, but it was for humans, and it went hundreds of miles into the sky seemingly into nowhere, endless sky tubes A lot of times I end up in this festival style place, and that's the hardest one to escape. It's fun.. your friends and or family are there and you don't want to leave. But I always have to, by the end of my time, regardless. I dunno what any of this is, how it's connected or why it makes sense but I just wanted to share my experience with this. A lot of the dreams in the beginning consisted of me running from agents or police officers/ building "workers" or me trying to get out of a cell with others that had no planned time of release.
